points.description: Says that on a flat region there is no change in any direction, and on an edge there is no change along the edge direction (change only across it).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of flat or edge is described, or stated vaguely.

points.description: Says that at a corner there is significant change in all directions (so direction-dependent intensity change is what identifies a corner).
points.partial_credit: Half if vaguely says corners depend on change in direction without stating all directions.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating the central idea in any wording: intensity change when the window shifts depends on direction — none on flat, none along an edge, large in all directions at a corner. Give part marks for a right-track but incomplete or vague answer, e.g. only mentioning edge or corner behaviour. No marks for unrelated or wrong answers. Mention of affine dependence is not needed.
